description: This file defines data models related to calendar days and events within the app's UI layer, including the CalendarDay, EventUI classes, and the EventTypeUI enum.

classes.name: CalendarDay
classes.description: Represents a specific day in the calendar with associated metadata such as date, whether it belongs to the current month, events, and if it is today.

classes.name: EventUI
classes.description: Models an event with an identifier, title, and type, representing calendar events in the UI.

classes.name: EventTypeUI
classes.description: Enumerates the types of events, specifically leave and holiday.
